host_and_graphon_statement.author_main_theorem: A finite simple undirected host G with at least one edge satisfies t(H,G)<p(G)^66, with p(G)=2e(G)/v(G)^2 and all homomorphisms including noninjective maps counted.
host_and_graphon_statement.actual_host_representation: Existence from a fixed finite nonnegative kernel, crossed-product symmetrization, scaling into [0,1], and independent sampling. No individual full host adjacency list is printed in the read sections.
host_and_graphon_statement.graphon_bridge: The symmetric finite [0,1]-valued probability kernel gives a step graphon with atom probabilities as interval lengths, in the requested original domain.
host_and_graphon_statement.ordinary_transfer_checked_conditionally: Conditional on the rank-layer lemma, symmetrization and finite-host transfer preserve the strict original gap: n>(595+66 mu^66)/Delta, collision fraction<=595/n, (1-1/n)^66>=1-66/n, and convexity give an ordinary finite host counting all homomorphisms.
host_and_graphon_statement.unread_dependency: Subsequent transverse/orbit/planted/singular-tail sections proving the rank-layer limit were not independently read or verified here.
